scope: HNK v1.1 spoken cardinal infrastructure for 0-9

decision.statement: Approve TEN_PRIMITIVE_DIGIT_NUMERALS as the authoring strategy for spoken HNK values 0 through 9, with each generated form remaining a proposal until its own candidate-promotion gate.

generation_constraints: Meaning 0-9 is fixed before form selection.
Use safe HNK40 transliteration units only unless a separately governed G-ID mapping is used.
Prefer short pronounceable forms and reject exact/near-confusion collisions.
Do not select forms by numerology, glyph appearance or assumed mystical correspondence.
Do not make numeral candidates FROZEN on first entry.
Do not decide 10-99 composition as a side effect of generating 0-9.
Generated forms require a separate human candidate-promotion decision before canonical registration.

progress_effect.reason: Strategy approval permits candidate generation only; OPI 3 remains HOLD until a sufficient spoken age answer system exists.
